# Assets

This directory contains images and media files for the project documentation.

## Panel Screenshot

Place your panel screenshot here as `panel.png` or `panel-screenshot.png`.

The image should show:
- Main dashboard or servers page
- Clean UI without sensitive data
- Recommended size: 1200x800px or similar aspect ratio
- Format: PNG or JPG

Then update the main README.md to reference it:
```markdown
![3X-UI Panel](.github/assets/panel.png)
```
